title.zh: 依第 45 条作出的命令
title.th: คำสั่งมาตรา 45

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-10_2000_E-ORDER-UNDER-SECTION-45.pdf》（1 页），本次切分 2 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: In exercise of the powers conferred by section 4(5) of the Fatal Accidents and Personal Injuries Act, I hereby amend section 4 of that Act by specifying that the sum to be awarded under section 4(3) as damages for bereavement shall be $15,000.00

This Order shall come into force on 1st. March, 2000, and shall have effect in relation to any action under the Act commenced after that date, whether or not the cause of action arose before it. Dated this 19th. day of Syawal, 1420 Hijriah corresponding to the 26th. day of January, 2000. ,,

DATO PADUKA AWANG KIFRAWI BIN

DATO PADUKA HAJI KIFLI

ATTORNEY GENERAL, BRUNEI DARUSSALAM.
